snippet.title: Super Mario 64 x DONKEY KONG BANANZA SHOWCASE?!
snippet.description:
This Super Mario 64 Coop DX Mod introduces Donkey Kong from Donkey Kong Bananza. From climbing walls, surfing through water, and punching enemies, Donkey Kong will run through every level

NOTE: I AM NOT THE CREATOR OF THIS MOD
Mod Commissioned by  @Drenchy   video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uwGa5fZmEA

Special Thanks:
Main Programming - Profejavix
DK Model +Animations - SwagSkeleton95
DK Facing Stars - Peachypeach
Stars Are Bananas - Maniscat
DK health texture - Baconator

DOWNLOAD LINK: https://mods.sm64coopdx.com/mods/cs-bananza-kong.1064/
Join the Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/7gr7pH9UkQ

0:00 Donkey Kong Montage
0:54 Donkey Kong Tutorial
2:18 Donkey Kong Speedrun
